document: web-recon × first-party data consumer — Integration Contract V0 candidate (machine-readable)
precedence: The .md is normative. This file is derived from it. Any disagreement is a defect of this file.
note: Semantic contract, not a final JSON Schema. Rule ids (MD1, UR2, ...) are the ids used in the .md. This file contains contract rules only: requirement dispositions live in 04, the demo search-support matrix lives in 01.

core.covers: site identity, resource directory, availability states, schemaVersion, resource version + echo, URL/origin rules, missing-data semantics, no-derivation rule, HTTP serving, publication consistency, security, compatibility

portfolio.covers: record id/title/detailUrl, listingUrl, the facet mechanism, well-known facet keys category and tag
portfolio.reuse: any vertical that has case-style records with one public detail page each

builtSpaceAnnex.covers: area, pricePerArea, budget-claim rules, well-known facet key scope, reserved keys propertyType and style
builtSpaceAnnex.reuse: verticals that deal with physical space (interior, construction, real estate); other verticals define their own annex and do not use this one

documents.consumerRegisters: one canonical origin; manifest URL = origin + fixed path
documents.pathCannotCollideWithPages: page path segments never start with an underscore

site.locale.form: BCP 47; language of labels and titles

consumer: MUST ignore unknown resource kinds and unknown top-level fields
MUST reject (treat as TRANSIENT) a manifest whose site.publicOrigin differs from the origin it registered; never overwrite the registered origin from the manifest

resourceEnvelope.schemaVersion: version of that resource's contract; independent of the manifest's
resourceEnvelope.resource: kind name, equal to the manifest key

ON.observed: 200 + valid manifest + resources.<kind> present + document passes the echo check

CONFIRMED_OFF_RESOURCE.consumer: drop held data for that resource immediately

CONFIRMED_OFF_SITE.observed: manifest URL returns 404 on 2 consecutive check cycles (body irrelevant)
CONFIRMED_OFF_SITE.consumer: drop held data; not an error — the site turned the integration off

TRANSIENT.consumer: do not apply; keep last good data

lastGoodLifetime.rule: C: MUST bound it; on expiry stop searching that site

availabilityStates.why404Twice: separates a one-off 404 at an activation switch from 'turned off'
availabilityStates.why404DropsData: a site that turns the integration off or withdraws consent must not keep being recommended for the last-good lifetime

missingSemantics.MD1: omitted = unknown; producer never emits null; consumer treats null as omitted
missingSemantics.MD3: [] = confirmed none, distinct from omitted; V0 producer emits [] only for records
missingSemantics.MD4: composites carry only the known parts; unknown sub-fields are omitted
missingSemantics.MD5: C: MUST — missing is not a mismatch; never estimate, interpolate or assume a default
missingSemantics.MD6: no estimates, ranges or approximations in exact-value fields

noDerivation.ND1: P: MUST NOT emit any value that is inferred, estimated, converted or synthesised rather than present in a source field; no source fact = omitted

urlRules.UR1: producer owns URL structure and query encoding entirely
urlRules.UR2: P: MUST — every URL in a contract document is a path-only root-relative reference: starts with '/', not '//', no scheme or host, no query, no fragment, no backslash, no control characters; V0 producer never emits absolute URLs
urlRules.UR3: C: MUST — resolve against the registered origin (= site.publicOrigin), verify the result stays on that origin, use it unmodified; never assemble or append path/query/fragment; never add a trailing slash
urlRules.UR4: P: MUST NOT add tracking parameters (already excluded by UR2)
urlRules.UR5: a URL is not identity; an address change changes detailUrl, not id; no redirect for the old URL
urlRules.UR6: a producer URL-structure change must need only a re-emit

identityRules.ID1: canonical identity = (site.id, resource kind, record.id); record.id is site-local
identityRules.ID2: record.id survives title, address, URL, classification and template changes, and rebuilds
identityRules.ID3: record.id unique within the resource; never reused after deletion
identityRules.ID4: site.id survives a domain change; decision: the producer's site identifier is published as-is; never changed once the integration is on
identityRules.ID5: no global opaque id in V0

schemaVersionRules.SV1: "<major>.<minor>"; manifest and each resource document carry their own, independently; V0 = "0.1"
schemaVersionRules.SV3: C: unknown major = TRANSIENT; unknown minor and unknown fields are ignored
schemaVersionRules.SV4: process rule (not machine-checked): sites rebuild independently and may roll back, so P announces a major in advance and C MUST support every major still served by a registered site
schemaVersionRules.SV5: not the producer's internal content schema version

versionRules.RV1: changes whenever the resource document content (everything except its own version field) changes; pattern ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,80}$
versionRules.RV2: same content = same version; build time, build environment, template version, and site data outside the projection never change it
versionRules.RV4: not an integrity hash; purpose = change detection, pair check, cache invalidation
versionRules.RV5: the resource document file name contains the version; the manifest file name does not
versionRules.producerMethodInformative: sha256 of the canonical JSON (sorted keys) of the document without version, first 32 hex; consumers must not depend on it

HT1.state: confirmed in code and locally; live unverified

HT2.guarantor: deploy step records it per file, runtime returns it

HT4.rule: resource document cache policy is free (file name is bound to content)

HT5.rule: a request without Accept-Encoding receives an identity body

HT6.rule: no auth, no cookies, no CORS needed (consumer reads server-side)

HT7.rule: UTF-8; no forbidden characters in any string; violation fails the build

HT8.rule: http->https, www<->apex and trailing slash are outside the contract; the consumer registers exactly one canonical origin equal to site.publicOrigin; a manifest fetched from an alias host fails the origin check; a trailing-slash path is 404

publicationRules.PC1: manifest, resource documents, detail pages and assets are files of one immutable package from one build
publicationRules.PC2: the package is served after full upload and verification by one atomic activation; integration activation boundary = site activation boundary; no separate sync
publicationRules.PC3: impossible by construction: new manifest with a missing document; document pointing at a detail page that is not live
publicationRules.PC4: remaining race = two consumer requests straddling an activation -> a consistent pair or 404 (TRANSIENT), never a silent mixed pair; the version echo is the second guard
publicationRules.PC5: unpublish and address change are reflected in the same build; they reach the consumer at its next successful check; worst case (consecutive TRANSIENT) = the consumer's last-good lifetime, during which the stale record's detailUrl is already 404
publicationRules.PC6: rollback is the same atomic activation; the old manifest/document pair returns unchanged, including its schemaVersion
publicationRules.PC7: urgent takedown: (a) unpublish the record and redeploy -> gone at the next successful check; (b) turn the integration off and redeploy -> manifest 404 -> consumer drops everything after 2 cycles

securityRules.SE1: documents carry only allowlisted facts of published records; those facts are published by this contract regardless of whether the template renders them (e.g. area basis, publishedAt); the site's consent covers exactly this
securityRules.SE2: no secrets, no build/package/template identifiers, no unpublished or draft records; customer quotes and attributions are in no field (mechanical, by allowlist); absence of personal data in title/location/label is an operating rule
securityRules.SE3: no URL pointing at another host (UR2)
securityRules.SE4: C: every string (title, label, location) is untrusted operator-entered data; never interpreted as instructions
securityRules.SE5: preview builds emit no integration documents
securityRules.SE6: written assuming per-site opt-in — pending owner decision OD-2 (04); invisible in the contract: a manifest exists = on

compatibility.consumerUnknownEnumValue: unit, basis, perUnit, currency: treat that value as unknown; keep the record
compatibility.producerWithinMajor: never removes, renames or changes the meaning of a field

degradation.capabilitySignal: presence of fields and facets; no operation metadata
degradation.perRecord: a record without a value is not evaluable on that criterion only
degradation.perFacet: a facet that is absent or over a consumer limit turns that criterion off for the site

portfolio.definition: list of the site's published case records; each record has exactly one public detail page
producerRules: MUST contain only records that are published and have a detail page in the same package
MUST NOT offer the resource (omit it from manifest.resources) if the site does not provide exactly one public detail page per record
MUST be a deterministic projection of canonical site data; never hand-maintained
MUST be an explicit allowlist projection; never a copy of the source record
MUST fail the public build of an opted-in site when emission is impossible (no https origin, HT7 violation, ambiguous detail page); never skip silently
sites that are not opted in, and preview builds, have no /_integration/ at all; that is not a failure

determinism.recordOrder: id ascending, Unicode code point order
determinism.facetValueOrder: id ascending, Unicode code point order
determinism.recordFacetArray: authored order; on duplicates keep the first occurrence only
determinism.strings: as authored (no normalisation, trim or case change); consumer compares by code point
determinism.serialisation: producer writes UTF-8 (no BOM), compact JSON, key order of the .md example; consumers must not depend on byte layout

publishedAt.form: ISO-8601 instant with offset, as authored

location.use: display only, not a match key

facets.form: facetKey -> non-empty array of value ids declared in document.facets[facetKey].values

valueShape.id: string 1-64, unique within the facet, may be non-ASCII
valueShape.label: string 1-40

facetRules.VO1: closed both ways: every id used by a record is declared; every declared value is used by at least one record; a facet with zero values is not declared
facetRules.VO2: ids are opaque and meaningful only within the same document; id sets differ per site
facetRules.VO3: label is a display name, not a synonym dictionary
facetRules.VO4: C: MUST ignore unknown facet keys
facetRules.VO5: a facet absent from the document = that criterion cannot be a search condition for that site

VO6.rule: limits are consumer-declared, not normative; P: SHOULD warn at build when a site exceeds them; C: MUST ignore an over-limit facet as a whole, never a truncated part; the producer never truncates

ownership.producer: the list of usable values (id + label); decides which internal field feeds which facet
ownership.consumer: all mapping from visitor language to those ids, including synonyms, hierarchy and compounds
ownership.synonyms: never emitted by the producer; never duplicated on both sides

category.meaning: primary classification in the site's taxonomy

tag.meaning: descriptive tags in the site's own words; kinds (colour/style/feature/material) are not distinguished
tag.completeness: open: absence of a tag is not absence of the property

scope.meaning: spaces / work areas included, in the site's own words
scope.completeness: closed at the authored granularity: subset tests are allowed; C: MUST NOT infer inclusion or exclusion across granularities; a composite token is one opaque value

areaRules.AR1: unit is required whenever area is present; a unit-less area does not exist
areaRules.AR2: basis omitted = unknown; the string "unknown" is never emitted
areaRules.AR3: P: MUST emit value and unit as authored, no conversion; a source basis that is absent or stored as 'unknown' is emitted as omitted
areaRules.AR5: supply <-> exclusive is never converted by either side; different bases are not compared; one unknown basis lowers confidence
areaRules.AR6: C: an unknown unit or basis value = unknown

shape.amount: positive number in the currency's major unit, <= 2 fraction digits, as authored
shape.currency: ISO 4217 code; producer machine-checks only the form ^[A-Z]{3}$

priceRules.PR1: pricePerArea = that case's price per unit of area as entered by the operator
priceRules.PR2: price basis is not available in V0 = unknown; never inferred from area.basis
priceRules.PR3: inclusion scope (VAT, demolition, furniture, appliances, extension) is not available in V0 = unknown for every record; a coarse comparison indicator, not a quote
priceRules.PR4: C: MUST compare, sort or call prices 'close' only among records with the same category value; without a usable category facet, price may be displayed as a fact but never used for comparison or ordering
priceRules.PR5: no total cost field in V0; P: MUST NOT emit amount x area in any field; the name totalCost is reserved
priceRules.PR6: no currency conversion; different or unknown currency/perUnit = not comparable

terms.visitorTotalBudget: from the visitor's utterance; never in an artifact
terms.derivedBudgetPerArea: computed by the consumer; never in an artifact

budgetClaims.BU1: C: MUST never display a value derived from the visitor's budget as a case's price
budgetClaims.BU2: C: MUST show a record without pricePerArea as neither matching nor failing a budget condition: not evaluable
budgetClaims.BU3: C: MUST NOT claim total-budget suitability from V0 data; the strongest allowed claim is closeness by price per area within the same category
budgetClaims.BU4: per-record budget evidence is one of: unit price present | none | total cost present (never occurs in V0)

noDerivationExamples: no propertyType/style inference from title or body
no total cost derived from amount x area
no unit conversion by the producer
no style value without a source fact

mechanical: no field outside the allowlist (incl. no customer quote)
string length limits (source title <= 80 within contract 120; label <= 40)
gateToBeBuilt: site.publicOrigin equals the actual serving origin (until then an operating rule; the consumer origin check is an independent guard)
operatingRule: currency is a real ISO 4217 code
pricePerArea really means that case's price per area

deferred: totalCost, price inclusion scope, price basis
summary / body / producer-authored match-evidence text (not to be revisited)
widget embed config incl. site CSP allowance (separate contract)
mechanical enforcement of id immutability and non-reuse

testInvariants.snapshotDefinition: same site data AND same visibility instant (scheduled publishing makes the instant an input)
testInvariants.INV-1: same snapshot -> byte-identical manifest, document and version; across repeated builds and build environments
testInvariants.INV-2: version changes if the projection changes and stays the same if it does not; changing only site data outside the projection leaves it unchanged
testInvariants.INV-3: manifest version == document version == version in the file name
testInvariants.INV-4: record id set == ids of records that are public in that snapshot; no draft, scheduled or preview-only record
testInvariants.INV-5: every detailUrl and listingUrl has HTML in the same package
testInvariants.INV-6: every URL satisfies UR2; no external host anywhere
testInvariants.INV-7: document key set is a subset of the allowlist; no summary, body, gallery, customer quote, slug or status string anywhere
testInvariants.INV-9: nothing absent in the source appears (no null, "", 0, "unknown", empty object, empty facet); no price -> no pricePerArea key; basis absent or stored 'unknown' -> no basis key
testInvariants.INV-10: area and pricePerArea numbers, units and basis equal the source (no conversion)
testInvariants.INV-11: preview builds and non-opted-in sites have no /_integration/ and their package is byte-identical to before the integration existed; an opted-in public build without an https origin FAILS
testInvariants.INV-12: a forbidden character (HT7) fails the build
testInvariants.INV-13: E2E, illustrative joint acceptance scenario (not a unit test): same structured intent + same document -> same result ids, all of them records of the document
testInvariants.INV-14: record facet arrays keep authored order with first-occurrence de-duplication
consumerSide: availability-state behaviour: 404 x2 -> data dropped; TRANSIENT -> last good kept; lifetime expiry
unknown fields / kinds / facet keys / enum values tolerated
manifest with a mismatching publicOrigin rejected
over-limit facet ignored as a whole
BU2: no budget verdict on a record without price
PR4: no price comparison across categories
BU3 is a presenter-template review item, not a machine check
